queue._section: === PHASE 2: VALIDATION & DEEP FOLLOW-ON (all require H200) ===

queue.name: Cross-match ALL anomaly catalogs against SIMBAD+NED+VizieR
queue.notes: For each survey: top 1000 anomalies vs SIMBAD, NED, VizieR. Classify known vs novel. This determines how many genuine discoveries we have.

queue.name: LAMOST 44K Anomaly Classification (UMAP+HDBSCAN)
queue.notes: Same pipeline as SDSS classification. Run locally. Identify high-z candidates, QSO candidates, artifacts.

queue.name: DESI 195K Anomaly Re-classification with optimized UMAP
queue.notes: Redo DESI clustering with tuned min_cluster_size. Compare taxonomy with SDSS/LAMOST.

queue.name: Planck × ACT CMB Anomaly Cross-Match
queue.notes: Check if the same sky regions are anomalous in both Planck and ACT. Independent confirmation = real signal.

queue.name: ACT DR6 Birefringence β from EB Cross-Spectrum
queue.notes: Compute β = 0.5*arctan(2*C_EB/(C_EE-C_BB)) from ACT IQU map. Compare with prediction β=0.27°. HIGH VALUE — direct bounce test.

queue.name: Anomaly Spatial Clustering Analysis (all surveys)
queue.notes: Angular correlation function of anomaly positions. Clustered = real large-scale structure signal. Uniform = systematic.

queue.name: Deep Analysis of z≈5.27 QSO (SDSS×DESI match)
queue.notes: Download full spectrum from DESI+SDSS. Emission line analysis. Check SIMBAD/NED. If uncataloged → discovery paper.

queue.name: NEOWISE 436 Anomalies × Optical Survey Cross-Match
queue.notes: Match NEOWISE IR anomalies against SDSS/DESI/PS1 photometry. Multi-wavelength characterization.

queue.name: Gaia 500 Anomalies × AAVSO/GCVS Variable Star Catalogs
queue.notes: Separate known variables from genuinely anomalous variability.

queue._section: === PHASE 3: F_NL + BOUNCE SCIENCE (the actual goal) ===

queue.name: f_NL Multi-Tracer Fisher Pipeline (DESI+SDSS+LAMOST)
queue.notes: Run run_full_fnl_pipeline.py. Measure b_g for anomaly-selected tracers. Compute σ(f_NL) improvement. THE key science deliverable.

queue.name: NANOGrav Proper Analysis via PTArcade/enterprise
queue.notes: Full Bayesian noise-marginalized fit. Include EPTA+PPTA data. Proper bounce GW template (not just power-law).

queue.name: Quintom Bounce MCMC with DESI DR2 + DES Y6
queue.notes: Rerun w0-wa CPL MCMC with latest data. Test quintom-B crossing. Confirm 2.3σ or update.

queue.name: Full Bayesian Bounce Model Comparison (4 models)
queue.notes: Matter bounce vs Cuscuton vs Ekpyrotic vs Quintom vs ΛCDM+inflation. Nested sampling for Bayes factors.

queue.name: BOSS/eBOSS DR16 Spectral Anomaly Scan
queue.notes: ~4M spectra. Different instrument from SDSS. Independent anomaly catalog.

queue.name: DES DR2 Photometric Anomaly Scan
queue.notes: ~700M objects. Photo-z + morphology + multi-band. Huge sample for f_NL tracers.

queue.name: ZTF Transient Alert Anomaly Scan
queue.notes: ~1B detections. Time-domain anomalies. Novel transients for follow-up.

queue.name: JWST Public Archive Anomaly Scan (NIRCam+NIRSpec)
queue.notes: Public JWST data from MAST. Highest-redshift objects. Unique wavelength coverage.

queue.name: Chandra Source Catalog 2.1 X-ray Anomaly Scan
queue.notes: ~400K X-ray sources. Deeper than eROSITA in pointed observations.

queue.name: XMM-Newton X-ray Archive Anomaly Scan
queue.notes: Largest X-ray observatory archive. Complements eROSITA and Chandra.

queue.name: VLASS Radio Continuum Anomaly Scan
queue.notes: VLA Sky Survey. Radio-selected anomalies for AGN/jet studies.

queue.name: SPT-3G CMB Maps Anomaly Scan
queue.notes: South Pole Telescope. Independent CMB experiment from Planck/ACT.

queue.name: TESS Full-Frame Image Light Curve Anomaly Scan
queue.notes: Time-domain photometry across nearly all-sky. Novel variability patterns.

queue.name: Pan-STARRS1 3π Survey Anomaly Scan
queue.notes: ~3B objects in 5 bands. Largest optical survey before LSST.

queue.name: Herschel Far-IR Archive Anomaly Scan
queue.notes: Far-infrared. Dust-obscured galaxies and star-forming regions.

queue.name: DESI DR1 Re-scan with Vision Transformer Anomaly Detector
queue.notes: Replace autoencoder with transformer architecture. Different anomaly ranking. Compare catalogs.

queue.name: SDSS DR18 Re-scan with Variational Autoencoder
queue.notes: VAE gives probabilistic anomaly scores + generative capability. Different anomaly distribution.

queue.name: Multi-Modal Cross-Survey Joint Training
queue.notes: Train single model on ALL survey features jointly. Learn cross-wavelength anomaly patterns.

queue.name: Contrastive Learning: Cross-Wavelength Anomaly Discovery
queue.notes: Objects that look normal in optical but weird in X-ray (or vice versa). SimCLR/BYOL architecture.

queue.name: NEOWISE Full-Sky Scan via AWS S3 Parquet
queue.notes: s3://nasa-irsa-wise/wise/neowiser/catalogs/p1bs_psd/healpix_k5/. Full 150B rows. The initial scan was only 1 sq deg.

queue.name: Gaia DR3 Full Variable Star Scan (1.8B sources)
queue.notes: Initial scan was 50K. Full catalog is 1.8B. Use epoch photometry partitioned files.

queue.name: Paper 3 — Multi-Survey Anomaly Catalog Full Draft
queue.notes: Integrate all 8 surveys, cross-match analysis, f_NL improvement, taxonomy, novel discoveries.

queue.name: Paper 5 — Novel Objects from AI Archival Mining
queue.notes: If z≈5.27 QSO or NEOWISE/Gaia objects are genuinely uncataloged → discovery paper.

queue.name: Paper 1 Update — NANOGrav BIC + Corrected Analysis
queue.notes: Add validated γ=3.20±0.42 result. BIC favors bounce. Update claims table.
